no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Lite Strategy (formerly MEI Pharma; renamed Sept 10, 2025) discontinued all clinical development. The voruciclib (CDK9 inhibitor) Phase 1 in AML+venetoclax was ceased July 22, 2024; zandelisib (PI3K-delta inhibitor) was globally terminated in 2023 with the Kyowa Kirin agreement. Both compounds are now described as pre-clinical assets undergoing further investigational research. The company implemented a Litecoin Treasury Strategy in August 2025 with $100M PIPE proceeds and is shifting toward digital-asset/Litecoin mining activities. No company-sponsored P1/P2/P3 clinical trials are active.
